name: ascenda
description: Ascenda — jogo de plataforma vertical de pulo carregado (pixel art 8-bit), HTML5 + Canvas.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync && node scripts/cap-native-setup.mjs
scripts.android:add: npm run build && npx cap add android && node scripts/cap-native-setup.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run build && npx cap sync android && node scripts/cap-native-setup.mjs && npx cap open android
scripts.ios:add: npm run build && npx cap add ios && node scripts/cap-native-setup.mjs && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/cap-native-setup.mjs && npx cap open ios
